moments.action: Black screen gives way to a dark curve of Earth lit by a thin orange sunrise, which brightens and rotates into the full Universal globe logo against starfield.
A heavily defocused mass of colour resolves as the lens pulls focus into a sunlit crowd of students outside a school, opening titles printed over them.
Students file through metal detectors past uniformed guards; a boy in a purple cap is checked, then the camera settles on a brown-haired teenager who spreads his arms and is patted down.
A red-haired student in a purple duck mascot suit waves a sword under a KILL THE INDIANS banner; the searched teenager turns and stares off, then a low angle follows legs through the churning crowd.
A high angle holds on the teenager, arms still out among guards, girls and the mascot, then the shot ends on a bank of CCTV monitors showing the same main entrance from above.
In class a hand sketches a car across a notebook instead of taking notes; the same teenager is seen head-down over the drawing, while behind him a teacher works through equations at the whiteboard.
A lunch tray with a wrapped burger, fries and a soda is carried through the crowd, then the frame swings into a blur of a blonde girl's hair passing close to camera.

A pep rally: purple-jerseyed players and a straw effigy ride a truck bed over cheering fans and DUCK FOOTBALL signs, then the cut lands close on the teenager turning away, a laughing blond boy behind him.
